intro: Our Caferia coffee table makes room for life’s little moments. Crafted with sturdy glass, sleek black legs, and open storage, we bring you beauty that feels light, effortless, and lasting.

features.title: Glass that’s built to last
features.text: Our 8 mm tempered glass top doesn’t just look sleek—it’s stronger and safer than ordinary glass. It’s designed to handle everyday life gracefully, with a load capacity of up to 40 kg.

features.title: No rust, no worries
features.text: The base is crafted from rust-free fibreglass—so you get all the strength and none of the maintenance. It keeps its integrity and finish through the years, even in humid conditions.

features.title: Bonded for brilliance
features.text: A stainless steel disc is UV-bonded to the base using transparent adhesive, creating a seamless connection that’s both strong and beautifully subtle.

features.title: Strong enough for real life
features.text: Whether it’s snacks, stacks of books, or a full dinner spread, our 40 kg load capacity handles it all—so you never have to think twice.

features.title: A finish that elevates your space
features.text: Available in a sleek black shade, our Caferia table adds modern elegance to any room. Its minimalist form pairs effortlessly with any décor style, from bold to understated.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
